name: suite-env-prefix-refused
body: Env-prefixed suite commands (APG_SUITE_E2E=1 bun test ...) are refused by the implementer's shell grant, so an ad-hoc opt-in suite run must either use Bun's automatic .env autoload in opencode-suite/ or, preferably, the gate script (scripts/gate.sh --e2e), which exports APG_SUITE_E2E itself. Limit: a one-off opt-in suite case cannot be run with a direct env-prefixed invocation. Upgrade when the shell grant admits env-prefixed commands, at which point the .env workaround and this note are obsolete.
